### Executive Summary
Chennai monsoon readiness is **fully approved and on track**. A flat **₹25 rain fee** was approved by VP Sameer Khan on Slack and goes live on **Monday 12 Oct** across Food and Instamart. The delivery partner incentive of **₹30/order plus a ₹200 bonus at 8+ orders** has been approved by Finance. Total programme cost is **~₹2.4 Cr**, largely offset by **~₹1.65 Cr** in rain fee revenue.

4. Fee to be labelled as a "Convenience fee" at checkout.
